title: Search Warrant Affidavit
summary: What a strong NJ search warrant application includes.

steps.text: Your training and experience relevant to this investigation
Specific facts, with dates, showing a crime was committed
Facts linking the evidence to the place to be searched (nexus)
Recent information; explain why it is not stale
Informants: basis of knowledge, reliability, and how you corroborated them (totality of the circumstances)
NJ has no good-faith exception: the affidavit must stand on its own
Exact description of the place: address, building, unit, vehicles, people
Specific list of items to be seized
Digital devices: say what data you want and why
No-knock entry: specific facts showing danger or destruction of evidence
Nighttime execution, if needed, with reasons
Execute within the time the warrant allows (R. 3:5-5)
Leave a copy and receipt; complete the inventory and return

note: Follow your department's policy and current AG directives. Not yet verified against official sources.
